post.description:
`ROLE REQUIRED: TD_AIAdmin` This call creates a new vector store and sets up its index. The embeddings are generated using configuration specified in vs_parameters and vs_index. For content-based vector store, the embeddings are generated using the contents of the tables and views specified in object_names. For metadata-based vector store, the embeddings are generated using the metadata of the tables and views specified using include_objects and include_patterns. For search_algorithm KMEANS and HNSW, index is also trained because of which, it may take longer to set up compared to vector distance. The resultant vector store is distributed leveraging MPP architecture and resides in the database specified in vs_index. ## vs_name Specifies the name of the vector store. This is a required argument. ## vs_index | Parameter | Description | Allowed Values | Default | | --------- | ----------- | -------------- | ------- | | **target_database** | Target database for the vectorstore. | String | Logged-in database | | **vector_column** | Column name to be used in the vector store containing embeddings.| String | `vector_index` | | ***CONTENT-BASED VS
FILE-BASED VS
EMBEDDING-BASED VS:*** | | **object_names** | List of tables and views to be indexed. If multiple objects are specified, all must have the same key columns and data columns. For file-based vector store, only one name should be specified to be used for file content splits. | List of Strings | `[]` | | **key_columns** | List of input column names to be used for indexing. Multiple key columns can be specified. For file-based vector store, this parameter is not needed. In case of multiple input files, a key_column containing the file names is generated. | List of Strings |
  • CONTENT/EMBEDDING-BASED VS: `['TD_ID']`
  • FILE-BASED VS: `['TD_ID', 'TD_FILENAME']`
| | **data_columns** | List of input column names to be used for embeddings (vectorization). When multiple data columns are specified, data is unpivoted to get a new key column "AttributeName" and a single data column "AttributeValue". For file-based vector store, it refers to the column name where the file content splits will be stored. | List of Strings |
  • CONTENT/EMBEDDING-BASED VS: `[]`
  • FILE-BASED VS: `['file_splits']`
| | ***EMBEDDING-BASED VS:*** | | **is_embedded** | Whether the input contains the embedding. | Bool | `False` | | **is_normalized** | Whether the input contains the normalized embedding.| Bool | `False` | | ***FILE-BASED VS:*** | | **chunk_size** | Number of characters in each chunk to be used during splitting of input file.| Int | `512` | | **optimized_chunking** | Whether an optimized splitting mechanism supplied by Teradata should be used. The documents are parsed internally in an intelligent fashion based on file structure and chunks are dynamically created based on section layout.| Bool | `True` | | **nv_ingestor** | Whether to use NVIDIA NV-Ingest for processing the document files.| Bool | `False` | | **extract_text** | Whether to extract text from the document files when using NVIDIA NV-Ingest.| Bool | `True` | | **extract_images** | Whether to extract images from the document files when using NVIDIA NV-Ingest.| Bool | `True` | | **extract_tables** | Whether to extract tables from the document files when using NVIDIA NV-Ingest.| Bool | `True` | | **extract_infographics** | Whether to extract infographics from the document files when using NVIDIA NV-Ingest.| Bool | `False` | | **extract_method** | Method to be used for extracting text from the document files when using NVIDIA NV-Ingest. |

get.description:
`ROLE REQUIRED: TD_AIAdmin or` 

`PERMISSION REQUIRED: ADMIN or USER`

IF get_details is set to True, this call gives the details of the vector store.

ELSE IF get_object_list is set to True, it returns the list of objects in the vector store. This usecase is applicable only for metadata-based vector stores.

ELSE this call gives the current status of the vector store / batch process and any error message if the vector store is in an error state.

put.summary: Grant or revoke USER/ADMIN permissions for a user on the vector store.
put.description:
`PERMISSION REQUIRED: ADMIN`

The user that creates a vector store becomes the sole ADMIN of the vector store.
This user can use this permissions API to authenticate other users access to this vector store.

The APIs for Update, Destroy, and Grant/Revoke Permissions need ADMIN permissions to the vector store.

The APIs for Similarity Search, Prepare Response, and Ask, Get Status and Get Details need USER permissions to the vector store.

post.summary: Perform similarity search in the vector store for the input question.
post.description:
`PERMISSION REQUIRED: ADMIN or USER`

The algorithm specified in search_algorithm is used to perform the search against the vector store.
The result contains top_k rows along with similarity score found by the search_algorithm to be most relevant to the question based on the specified metric.
This API is supported for both content-based and metadata-based vector stores.
